notes: Fixed picture-book and bedtime-story sound slots. freesound_id and preview_url stay empty until scripts/build_sfx_catalog.py runs with FREESOUND_API_KEY. Story requests may use only these entries.

entries.label: Dog bark
entries.description: One friendly bark for a picture-book dog.

entries.label: Cat meow
entries.description: A single house-cat meow.

entries.label: Bird chirp
entries.description: A short songbird chirp, not a dawn chorus.

entries.label: Owl hoot
entries.description: One or two soft owl hoots for a night page.

entries.label: Horse neigh
entries.description: A short horse neigh.

entries.label: Frog croak
entries.description: A single frog ribbit beside a pond.

entries.label: Bee buzz
entries.description: A close bee buzz, short enough for one sentence.

entries.label: Lion roar
entries.description: A short, storybook lion roar rather than a long scream.

entries.label: Mouse squeak
entries.description: A tiny mouse squeak.

entries.label: Duck quack
entries.description: One or two duck quacks.

entries.label: Cow moo
entries.description: A single cow moo.

entries.label: Sheep baa
entries.description: A sheep or lamb bleat.

entries.label: Rain
entries.description: Gentle rainfall for a rainy page, not rain hitting a window.

entries.label: Wind
entries.description: A soft, steady breeze through an outdoor scene (ambience bed).

entries.label: Thunder
entries.description: Distant soft thunder, not a sharp crack next to the listener.

entries.label: Stream
entries.description: A small brook or stream.

entries.label: Ocean waves
entries.description: Gentle waves on a shore.

entries.label: Leaves rustle
entries.description: A short rustle of leaves or a bush, as if something moves through the foliage (one-shot, not a wind bed).

entries.label: Campfire
entries.description: Wood crackling in a small campfire.

entries.label: Crickets
entries.description: Night crickets chirping, a steady ambience bed.

entries.label: Door creak
entries.description: A wooden door opening with a creak.

entries.label: Door close
entries.description: A door shutting, without a long creak.

entries.label: Footsteps on wood
entries.description: A few footsteps on a wooden floor.

entries.label: Soft footsteps
entries.description: Quiet, padded footsteps - tiptoeing or soft steps on carpet.

entries.label: Clock tick
entries.description: A steady clock tick for a quiet room.

entries.label: Kettle whistle
entries.description: A kettle starting to whistle.

entries.label: Pages turning
entries.description: Paper pages turning in a picture book.

entries.label: Blanket rustle
entries.description: Cloth or a blanket moving, as someone settles into bed.

entries.label: Magic chime
entries.description: A bright magical chime or sparkle, like a spell being cast or fairy dust sprinkling.

entries.label: Twinkle
entries.description: A tiny twinkle or glint, like a star appearing or a sparkle in someone's eye.

entries.label: Whoosh
entries.description: A soft, airy whoosh for something flying or zooming past.

entries.label: Soft bell
entries.description: A single soft bell, not a bicycle bell.

entries.label: Harp flourish
entries.description: A short dreamy harp flourish or pluck (not a tune), for dreams, wishes or 'once upon a time'.

entries.label: Train whistle
entries.description: A short train whistle.

entries.label: Bicycle bell
entries.description: A bicycle bell ring.

entries.label: Car horn
entries.description: A short, polite car horn.

entries.label: Boat horn
entries.description: A distant boat or ship horn.

entries.label: Kids laughter
entries.description: A short, gentle burst of a young child giggling (no shrieks or words).

entries.label: Soft gasp (group)
entries.description: A small audience-style 'ooh' gasp of surprise or wonder, not fear.

entries.label: Soft applause
entries.description: Light applause, a few people clapping.

entries.label: Heartbeat
entries.description: A slow, soft, calm heartbeat (a few gentle beats), not a tense or scary one.

entries.label: Yawn
entries.description: A yawn for a sleepy character.

entries.label: Rooster
entries.description: A morning rooster crow.

entries.label: Rain on window
entries.description: Raindrops tapping a window, distinct from open rainfall.

entries.label: Morning birds
entries.description: A short dawn chorus of several birds.

entries.label: Cat purr
entries.description: A soft, steady, content cat purr (a few seconds), not a meow.

entries.label: Pig oink
entries.description: A short, friendly pig oink or grunt, not a squeal.

entries.label: Chicken cluck
entries.description: A hen softly clucking, not a morning rooster crow.

entries.label: Horse hooves
entries.description: Clip-clop hoofbeats of a trotting horse (a few seconds), not a neigh.

entries.label: Door knock
entries.description: Two or three friendly knocks on a wooden door.

entries.label: Doorbell
entries.description: A classic ding-dong house doorbell, not a shop bell or a bicycle bell.

entries.label: Stairs creak
entries.description: A creaky wooden stair step or floorboard.

entries.label: Clock chime
entries.description: A short excerpt of a mantel or grandfather clock chiming the hour.

entries.label: Telephone ring
entries.description: An old-fashioned bell telephone ringing, not a modern ringtone.

entries.label: Footsteps in leaves
entries.description: Walking through crunchy dry autumn leaves.

entries.label: Running footsteps
entries.description: Someone running, a short burst of quick steps.

entries.label: Magic poof
entries.description: A soft cartoon puff of magical smoke as something appears or vanishes.

entries.label: Treasure jingle
entries.description: Gold coins and jewels jingling and clinking, for finding treasure.

entries.label: Treasure chest
entries.description: An old wooden chest lid creaking open.

entries.label: Dragon roar
entries.description: A short, friendly storybook dragon roar, a single burst, not scary.

entries.label: Train chug
entries.description: A steam train chugging along for a few seconds, not the whistle.

entries.label: Sleigh bells
entries.description: A short jingle of sleigh bells.

entries.label: Cartoon boing
entries.description: A springy cartoon boing, for bouncing or springing up.

entries.label: Comic thud
entries.description: A soft comic bump or thud when someone falls over or tumbles.

entries.label: Ball bounce
entries.description: A toy ball bouncing a few times.

entries.label: Wind gust
entries.description: One short gust of wind, not a long breeze bed.

entries.label: Snow crunch
entries.description: A few footsteps crunching in snow.

entries.label: Splash
entries.description: One splash, like someone jumping into water.

entries.label: Water drip
entries.description: A few water drips, like a leaky tap or a cave, not rainfall.

entries.label: Waterfall
entries.description: A small waterfall, a steady ambience bed rather than a canyon roar.

entries.label: Twig snap
entries.description: One dry twig snapping underfoot.

entries.label: Soft snore
entries.description: A gentle cartoonish snore, a few breaths, for a character falling asleep.

entries.label: Sneeze
entries.description: A cute, short 'achoo' sneeze (no words), for a funny moment.

entries.label: Small cheer
entries.description: A brief happy cheer from a small group ('yay!'), for a celebration.

entries.label: Bird wings
entries.description: A bird taking off: a quick flutter of wings, no chirp.

entries.label: Wolf howl
entries.description: Wolves howling far away on a moonlit night, soft and distant, not a close snarl.

entries.label: Elephant trumpet
entries.description: A short elephant trumpet call.

entries.label: Bear growl
entries.description: A low, grumbly bear rumble for a picture-book bear, not an attack snarl.

entries.label: Seagull cry
entries.description: A few seagull calls at the seashore.
